prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 5 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1303; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection, reporting headache, dizziness, and difficulty concentrating consistent with concussion. The mechanism of injury and the force involved are well matched to the symptoms described. Initial examination documented post-concussive findings, and imaging obtained during the course of care clearly confirmed the injury. Over five outpatient visits, management followed a typical course of symptom monitoring, cognitive and vestibular rest guidance, and graded activity advice. Symptoms improved steadily, and visit frequency was tapered as recovery progressed. The patient reports a remote, minor strain in the same region years earlier, which resolved completely without residual limitation. Billing records reflect single entries for each service with no repeated charges. Ongoing follow-up is recommended only if new or worsening symptoms develop.
